none: PAS NLM-62A8A8: Roman Seal Box Lid
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy seal box lid. Cast rhomboid plate with a knop at either end of its long axis on its upper side. Below these, paired lugs at one end are for a hinged fastening, with a smaller sub-triangular lug at the opposite end to engage a catch to ensure closure.
